resources.string: Set up Nexus for your parent
Nexus lets them call family by voice, check a suspicious message, and ask you before they act. It takes about 5 minutes.
Which language does your parent speak?
This phone has no %1$s voice yet, so Nexus can\'t speak in it. You can add the voice now (it downloads once).
Setting it up for yourself? That works too.
Add up to 4 people. Choose at least one to get “Is this real?” questions.
Turn on “Gets Is-this-real questions” for at least one person.
That contact\'s number can\'t be used. Type it instead.
Name, as your parent says it
Add a name for this number.
Indian mobile numbers start with 6, 7, 8 or 9.
Suggestions send what you type to a map service. The saved address stays on this phone.
So your parent can say “Call Rahul” instead of searching contacts. Nexus listens only after they press Speak.
Nexus needs the microphone to hear you. It listens only after you press Speak.
Your voice is understood on this phone.
Google\'s speech service turns your voice into text. Nexus keeps only the words, never the recording.
So Nexus can place the call itself after a 3-second Stop button, without the dial pad step. If you say no, the dial pad opens and they press the green button.
Nexus only calls the people you saved.
All set. Hand the phone to your parent.
Nexus will switch to their language and ask them to press the mic and say “%1$s”.
The microphone is off, so the voice try-out is skipped. Turn it on later in Family settings.
For family: hold 2 seconds for settings
The dial pad is open. Press the green button to call.
Your voice stays on this phone.
Online: Google turns your voice into words.
Didn\'t catch that. Say again or tap a photo.
No problem. Tap the photo of who you want to call.
Nothing copied yet. Long-press the message, tap Copy, then come back.
In WhatsApp or Messages, long-press the message, tap Share, then choose Nexus.
No words found in that picture. Try pasting the message instead.
Stop! This could be a scam
This does not mean it is safe. If it asks for money or a code, ask family first.
Asks for your OTP or PIN
Asks you to enter your UPI PIN to “receive” money. You never need a PIN to receive.
Asks you to install a screen-sharing app
Has a link to an app file (.apk)
The link pretends to be a bank or company but is a different site
Says your account or connection will be blocked
Has a short link that hides where it goes
Has a link to an unknown site
Promises a prize, lottery or cashback
Offers easy money for tasks or part-time work
Talks about a refund or payment you didn\'t expect
Says “this is my new number” and asks for money
Never share OTP or PIN with anyone. Banks never ask for it.
WhatsApp will open with %1$s. You press Send.
Messages will open with %1$s. You press Send.
Choose an app, then %1$s, then press Send.
WhatsApp will open. Choose %1$s, then press Send.
No cab app is on this phone.
Please book me a ride home.
You check the fare and confirm in the cab app.
Address copied. Paste it in “Where to”.
Days used: %1$d · Calls: %2$d · Voice commands: %3$d · Messages checked: %4$d · Asked family: %5$d · Rides: %6$d · WhatsApp: %7$d · Messages sent: %8$d
Only counts and the feedback answers. No names, numbers or messages.
When you press Speak, Google\'s speech service on this phone turns your voice into words, which may use the internet. Nexus keeps only the words, never a recording.
Messages and screenshots are checked on this phone and not saved. Nexus never reads your SMS or chats by itself.
Your people, home address, language and usage counts (no words, names or places), only on this phone. Not in Android backup. Delete them any time in How Nexus is doing.

Address suggestions while typing a home address (a map search service), the phone\'s own location service to place home on the map, and the speech service if it is online. Nexus has no account and no ads. Daily usage counts go to the Nexus team only if your family turns that on (off unless you say yes).
The home address will be copied. Paste it in “Where to”.
Ask family to install Uber, Ola or Rapido.
Nothing is shared without your yes
Nexus never sends a message, call or summary on its own: it leaves this phone only when you press Send, Call or Share. The one exception is daily counts, and only if your family turned them on.
%1$s is not saved. Tap who should get it.
Tap the message to change it
WhatsApp will open with this message written. Then you tap the green Send button there.
Messages will open with this message written. Then you tap Send there.
Could not open the app. Try the other button.
In Maps, tap a place to see its phone number and the Call button.
Install it from the Play Store. Downloading it is free.
Please help me install %1$s on my phone.
Pick one app for each need. Your parent sees big buttons in their language, not app icons. Apps not on this phone can be installed from the Play Store.
Couldn’t find the PIN from the address. Type the 6-digit PIN.
Used to search nearby places. Nexus can’t check if an app delivers here: open the app once to check.
Near home: groceries %1$d · medicines %2$d · doctor %3$d · ride %4$d · home help %5$d · emergency %6$d
Opens the dial pad with %1$s. Press the green button to call.
Speak now. Take your time, then tap Done.
To call or message “%1$s”, Nexus needs to look in your phone book.
Your contacts stay on this phone. Nexus never uploads or saves them.
I couldn’t find “%1$s” in your phone book.
Let Nexus look in this phone’s phone book, so “Sunil la phone lav” works for anyone saved here. Contacts stay on this phone.
I couldn’t find “%1$s” on the map. The cab app can search for it.
The address will be copied. Paste it in “Where to”.
Please book me a ride to %1$s.
Counts from this phone only. No voice, no words said, no names, numbers or places.
Used on %1$d of the last 7 days
After setup, used on day 1: %1$s · day 7: %2$s · day 30: %3$s
Came straight back (wrong app, within 5 seconds): %1$s
Setup not finished, stopped at step %1$d
Voice worked within 24 hours of setup: %1$s
First thing done, %1$d min after setup
Goes with the summary so family kindness doesn\'t skew the numbers.
Counts only, as text you can read first. Send it on WhatsApp to the Nexus team.
Send daily counts to the Nexus team
Off. Nothing is sent. You can still share the summary yourself.
On. Once a day, yesterday\'s counts go to the Nexus team. Turn off any time.

Opens and days used, setup steps and time, which permissions were allowed, voice tries and whether they were understood, how long speaking took, the kind of app opened (call, WhatsApp, cab, maps), Near home taps, and crashes. Kept on this phone for 90 days.
Voice recordings, the words said, message text, names, phone numbers, addresses or places, the Android ID or the advertising ID.
This deletes every count and the feedback answers on this phone, turns off daily counts and gives this phone a new random code. Your people and places stay.
This helps the Nexus team see if Nexus really works for parents. It is off unless you say yes.
What is sent, once a day

Yesterday\'s counts: opens, voice tries and how many were understood, buttons used, the kind of app opened, setup steps and crashes. With a random code made for this phone, the app version, the language and who is testing (family, friend or stranger).
A small Nexus server on Cloudflare, only for the Nexus team. Kept for 180 days. Turning this off stops it at once; Delete all usage data also gives this phone a new code.
No, keep it on the phone
